name: AIHOT AI Hot Topics Site with Daily Reports
idSeed: AIHOT 2026.11 AI Hot Topics Site with Daily Reports
description: Self-hosted AI news site: LLM-scored picks, trending events, daily reports

upstream.license: MIT (the AIHOT name and logo are not licensed)

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; the public domain and Railway's healthcheck (/gateway-health) use it.

AIHOT_WEB_UPSTREAM.description: Private host:port of the Web service that Caddy forwards every request to.

PORT.description: Port of the web server (dual-stack ::); Railway's healthcheck uses it at /terms, a page that renders without the API.

API_BASE_URL.description: Backend API over the private network: page data (SSR) and every API-owned path (/api/*, RSS, sitemap, images, MCP) is proxied there.

SITE_URL.description: Address readers use. Links, RSS, sitemap, share images and MCP host checks use it; set https://{your-domain} after adding a custom domain (Backend follows).

TRUST_PROXY.description: Read the visitor address from X-Forwarded-For (set by the Gateway) so sign-in and feedback limits count real visitors. Keep true: Web has no public domain.

AIHOT_SOURCE_REPO.description: Build source, from Backend (both services must run the same code).

PORT.description: API port (dual-stack ::). Railway's healthcheck calls /api/health here, which also checks the database.

LLM_API_KEY.description: Required for selection and write-ups: API key of any OpenAI-compatible model service (DeepSeek by default). The site boots without it, but items wait unscored until it is set. Billed by that provider.

LLM_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the model service, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

LLM_MODEL.description: Model every step uses unless changed per step in the admin (Models page) or with PREFILTER_MODEL, SCORE_MODEL, ...

LLM_EXTRA_JSON.description: Provider-specific request fields as JSON. The default turns DeepSeek's thinking off; clear it for providers that reject unknown fields (OpenAI).

LLM_REASONING_TOKENS.description: Only for reasoning models: extra output tokens per call for the reasoning, e.g. 4000 (set it when calls fail with finish_reason=length).

LLM_VISION.description: true if the model accepts images (selected items then also use their first image).

EMBEDDING_BASE_URL.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible /embeddings service (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1) for better event grouping and heat; empty = text-overlap matching.

COLLECT_ENABLED.description: Safety valve: only 'true' fetches sources (and their icons). Set false to pause collection.

MODEL_CALLS_ENABLED.description: Safety valve: only 'true' calls models. Set false to stop all model spending.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for /admin, generated at deploy (at least 12 characters). Changing it signs out existing admin sessions.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs admin sessions; generated. Rotating it signs everyone out.

IMG_PROXY_SIGN_SECRET.description: Signs image-proxy URLs so the proxy only fetches images the site itself links; generated.

SITE_URL.description: Same public address as Web (change it there).

INGEST_TOKEN.description: Optional token (16+ characters) that turns on POST /api/ingest/items for your own scripts to push items; empty keeps the endpoint off.

INGEST_RATE_LIMIT.description: Pushes per client and minute on /api/ingest/items (upstream compose default); 0 turns the limit off.

SOCIALDATA_API_KEY.description: Optional, paid per request: SocialData key for X (Twitter) account sources. Budget limits are in the admin settings.

JINA_API_KEY.description: Optional, paid per request: Jina Reader key, a browser-rendered fallback when a page's full text cannot be fetched.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional read-only GitHub token for JSON sources on api.github.com (higher rate limit).

DB_BACKUP_STORE_SECRET_ID.description: Bucket access key for the daily backup (pg_dump + uploads, 04:10 China time).

DB_BACKUP_STORE_SECRET_KEY.description: Bucket secret key for the daily backup.

DB_BACKUP_STORE_BUCKET.description: Bucket the backups go to (daily/, weekly/, monthly/ prefixes).

TEMPLATE_BACKUP_ENDPOINT.description: Bucket endpoint; the template derives DB_BACKUP_STORE_DOMAIN ({bucket}.{endpoint host}, virtual-hosted style) from it.

TEMPLATE_BACKUPS.description: false turns the daily backup to the Bucket off.

TEMPLATE_BACKUP_ON_BOOT.description: true runs one backup right after each start (to test the Bucket wiring or before an upgrade); set it back to false afterwards.

TEMPLATE_SEED_SOURCES.description: Each deploy adds the sources of industry/sources.json that are missing (18 AI news feeds upstream). Pause unwanted sources in the admin instead of deleting them, or set false.

AIHOT_SOURCE_REPO.description: Build your own fork: owner/name of a public GitHub repo made from AIHOT. Empty = KKKKhazix/AIHOT. Web uses the same value.

AIHOT_SOURCE_COMMIT.description: Full 40-character commit SHA to build. Empty = the pinned snapshot 0ce2d00fd80b (2026-11-07).

AIHOT_SOURCE_SHA256.description: SHA-256 of the commit's codeload tarball; verified when set (the pinned snapshot is always verified). The build log prints it.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds a redeploy waits for the worker to finish in-flight model calls and backups before stopping it (upstream allows up to 470).

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first boot; AIHOT's migrations create its tables (and pg_trgm) here.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection string; Backend references it.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Superuser password, generated at deploy (letters only, so it is safe inside DATABASE_URL). Changing it later needs ALTER USER too.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down
